# MikroTik
> MikroTik develops networking hardware and RouterOS software for routing, switching, wireless, LTE/5G, and ISP infrastructure.

MikroTik provides routers, switches, wireless systems, accessories, and network operating software used by home users, enterprises, wireless ISPs, and integrators worldwide. The site includes product catalogs, software downloads, changelogs, and RouterOS licensing information.

## Product Catalog
- [All Products](https://mikrotik.com/products): Browse the complete MikroTik hardware product catalog across all categories.
- [New Products](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/new): View the latest MikroTik hardware releases and recently added products.
- [Hardware Overview](https://mikrotik.com/hardware): Explore MikroTik hardware categories and product families.
- [Software](https://mikrotik.com/software/all): Browse MikroTik software products, editions, and licensing options.

## Routers and Switching
- [Ethernet Routers](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/ethernet-routers): Wired routing platforms for enterprise, ISP, and edge network deployments.
- [Switches](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/switches): Managed Ethernet switches for access, aggregation, and data center use.
- [RouterBOARD](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/routerboard): RouterBOARD hardware platforms for custom routing and embedded networking solutions.
- [Interfaces](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/interfaces): Network interface cards and expansion options for MikroTik systems.
- [SFP/QSFP](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/sfp-qsfp): Optical transceivers and high-speed modules for fiber and uplink connectivity.

## Wireless Networking
- [Wireless Systems](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/wireless-systems): Outdoor and indoor wireless platforms for point-to-point and access deployments.
- [Wireless for Home and Office](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/wireless-for-home-and-office): Wi-Fi products designed for residential and small office networking.
- [60 GHz Products](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/60-ghz-products): High-capacity 60 GHz wireless links for short-range backhaul and bridging.
- [Antennas](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/antennas): Antennas for wireless links, sector coverage, and directional deployments.

## Mobile and IoT Connectivity
- [LTE/5G Products](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/lte-5g-products): Cellular networking devices for mobile broadband, failover, and remote connectivity.
- [IoT Products](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/iot-products): Connectivity products for telemetry, remote monitoring, and industrial IoT use cases.

## Components and Accessories
- [Enclosures](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/enclosures): Cases and housing options for embedded boards and custom installations.
- [Accessories](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/accessories): Power supplies, mounting kits, cables, and other deployment accessories.
- [Interfaces](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/interfaces): Add-on interfaces for extending connectivity and hardware capabilities.
- [Antennas](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/antennas): Wireless antenna options for indoor, outdoor, and sector applications.

## Software and Licensing
- [Software Catalog](https://mikrotik.com/software/all): Overview of MikroTik software offerings and RouterOS-related products.
- [Downloads](https://mikrotik.com/download): Download RouterOS, utilities, firmware, and related software packages.
- [Changelogs](https://mikrotik.com/download/changelogs): Review RouterOS and software release notes, fixes, and version changes.

## Downloads and Updates
- [Downloads](https://mikrotik.com/download): Central download page for RouterOS, firmware, and MikroTik utilities.
- [Changelogs](https://mikrotik.com/download/changelogs): Detailed software changelogs for tracking updates and regressions.
- [Software](https://mikrotik.com/software/all): Access software editions and related product information before downloading.

## Specialized Product Groups
- [New Products](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/new): Recently introduced hardware and newly available MikroTik devices.
- [Accessories](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/accessories): Supporting hardware for installation, power, and maintenance tasks.
- [Enclosures](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/enclosures): Protective housings for boards and embedded networking builds.
- [RouterBOARD](https://mikrotik.com/products/group/routerboard): Embedded board platforms for integrators and custom device builders.
